definitions.gloss: proposal; suggestion; coming up with an idea; initiative
definitions.explanation: The act of conceiving and proposing an idea or plan. Emphasizes the origination of an idea rather than its execution.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発案|はつあん}だ。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発案|はつあん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new system was introduced at the president's initiative.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発案|はつあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧ことで、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: By actively adopting suggestions from subordinates, the workplace atmosphere improved.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb ({発案|はつあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Often used to credit the origin of an idea or initiative. The person who came up with the idea is the {発案者|はつあんしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発案|はつあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to propose, to come up with an idea)
- {発案者|はつあんしゃ} (originator, person who proposed)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発案|はつあん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at the initiative of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧: proposal, suggestion — more formal, emphasizes the act of presenting an idea to others
- ⟦{考案|こうあん}→考案：13906_kouan⟧: devising, inventing — emphasizes the creative thinking process
